description: Did this settled Solana payment deliver the expected amount to the expected recipient? When to use: After a payment has been submitted: to confirm from the chain that the recipient received the mint and amount you expected, including the Token-2022 fee case. Prefer another tool: Before sending a transfer (use `/v1/solana/transfer-readiness`), or to list a wallet's transfers or balances (none are returned). Example: solana_payment_verify {"signature":"B7yABUkY4RudiDfoax94mfqVv2YuNJ4AVsg7LjdFT9Qm8bScsw3PoB2LxpuUqzCkiniKQJ9AKXfSfWaw1kWYFaF","recipient":"GEJySUi6LjHwQWKD2BDg3TiGKwhKmBU7JJTjZfk1RD54","mint":"SOL","amount":"0.02"}

amount.description: Positive decimal amount the payment had to deliver, in UI units (not lamports or raw units); at most 9 decimals for SOL

mint.description: `SOL` for native SOL, or the mint address of the SPL Token or Token-2022 token the payment had to deliver

recipient.description: Wallet the payment had to reach (not its token account): Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

reference.description: Reference key the payment had to carry among its account keys: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes; omit to skip the reference check

signature.description: Transaction signature of the payment to verify: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 64 bytes

source.description: Wallet the payment had to be signed by: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes; omit to skip the sender check

name: solana_payment_verify

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time

as_of.description: When we read the data from Solana (our read time)

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Lowest context slot of the finalized reads behind the answer; null when none of them carries one, never 0

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

asset.description: The `mint` the request named, or `SOL` for native SOL

anyOf.description: Decimal string in units of `asset` (SOL, or token units)

value.description: The same amount as `value_atomic` in units of `asset`; null when the mint's decimals are unknown

value_atomic.description: What the recipient's own balance gained in raw base units of `asset`, net of a Token-2022 transfer fee; a closed token account counts its whole balance as a negative delta

delivered.description: What was delivered to the recipient; null when there is no transaction to read

asset.description: The `mint` the request named, or `SOL` for native SOL

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset` (SOL, or token units)

value_atomic.description: Decimal integer string in raw base units (lamports for SOL)

excess.description: Delivered minus expected when `paid`, the same amount object as `expected` and `delivered`, exact in both units; null otherwise

expected.description: The amount the request asked to confirm

asset.description: The `mint` the request named, or `SOL` for native SOL

value.description: The request's `amount` as its canonical exact decimal (`1.50` is `1.5`), in units of `asset`

anyOf.description: Decimal integer string in raw base units (lamports for SOL)

value_atomic.description: The same amount in raw base units (lamports for SOL); null when the mint does not appear in the transaction's token balances, so its decimals are unknown

failure_code.description: The error variant name of the transaction's `meta.err` (the string, or the single key of a one-key object), such as `InstructionError`, never the error object itself; `unknown_error` when the error has any other shape or its name does not match ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,40}$. Null when the transaction did not fail or there is no transaction

reference.description: Reference key queried (echo of `reference`, the Solana Pay marker); null when the request sent none

settled_at.description: When the payment settled: the block time of that slot; null when there is no transaction or the block time is unavailable

slot.description: Slot holding the transaction; null when there is no transaction

source.description: Signing wallet queried (echo of `source`); null when the request sent none

flag.description: Which side is assumed at par: the USD peg (`assumed_parity`) or the EUR peg

fx_rate_date.description: Date of the ECB reference rate used, the latest on or before the payment's date

note.description: That the value is an informative reference, not a tax figure

usd_per_eur.description: The ECB reference rate used, in USD per EUR, as stored; `value_eur` = `value_usd` / `usd_per_eur`

value_eur.description: Delivered value in EUR, a decimal string rounded half-up to 18 decimal places

value_usd.description: Delivered value in USD, a decimal string rounded half-up to 18 decimal places

verdict.description: The first verdict that matches, in the documented order

title: Solana payment verify
